# AIRA Journal publishes an article by Katharine Wolanyk and Christopher Freeman


- Patent & IP


May 16, 2024


-
-
-
-


*AIRA Journal* published an article by[Katharine Wolanyk](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/katharine-wolanyk/) and[Christopher Freeman](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christopher-freeman/) on financed corporate patent divestitures. This article first appeared in the *2024 Legal Trends Issue* of the[Burford Quarterly](https://www.burfordcapital.com/eu/insights-news-events/burford-quarterly/2024-issue-1/) .


[Click here to view full article.](https://www.aira.org/pdf/journal/2024_v37_n2.pdf)
